title: Second block of a concatenated cube vector
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $i$ be an index from $0$ to $n-1$. The vector formed by concatenating $x$ and $y$, evaluated at the position corresponding to index $i$ in the second block, has value $y_i$.
